ENGLISH: The People of the Grozny host are backwards savages, we will teach them the gospel and give them the benefits of civilization.
The Northern regions would give us a bit of breathing room and distance between the Armenian heartland and the dangerous cossacks.

The people of Azerbaijan have long worshipped the Islamic faith, posing a danger to our nation. Yet Jesus said one should love his neighbour, and if we wish to truly stand as a guardian of Christendom then we must ensure stability within our nation. The Azeri people will be embraced with open arms and given the rights they deserve.

The Georgians are christians, yet have long eluded becoming a proper part of our state. We will elevate them to have the same rights as any other Christian man within our nation, and unite our people.

We have established ourselves as a powerful and stable actor in the middle east. Our enemies may try to stop us, and shall then be met with our ferocious armies and impassable mountains. Armenia has lasted for over 2000 years, and shall last for 2000 more.
